content:
We are hiring, looking for someone experienced in using AI (e.g. codex-cli with skills/hooks) to accelerate formal proof/spec development. 
Our new blogpost explains our past and planned work and has a link to our formal job posting with application link: https://category-labs.github.io/category-research/formalverif/blogs/frontier-models/
We currently do our proofs in Rocq but we are open to moving to Lean once the projects we depend on are ported to Lean: Iris separation logic and BRiCk semantics of C++.
hi Abhishek, I am experienced in using AI to accelerate the development, may I know how to contact you so that I can send my cv to you.
Thanks for your interest. You can apply here. I just edited the post above to clarify how to apply.
